当应用需要集成完整的手写体验时使用本Kit的手写套件能力
手写套件提供了开箱即用的画布和工具栏组件，包含多种笔刷效果、橡皮擦、套索编辑等工具，适合笔记、绘图、签名等手写场景
当需要单独使用报点预测、一笔成形、全局取色或手写交互等独立能力时也可使用本Kit
这些能力可以按需集成，不一定需要完整的套件组件
实现手写批注和自由涂鸦画布 / Implement handwritten annotation and a freehand drawing canvas
接入触控笔低延迟书写并优化跟手效果 / Integrate low-latency stylus writing and improve ink responsiveness
添加压感和倾斜角控制线条粗细与笔触 / Add pressure and tilt support to control stroke width and brush feel
实现橡皮擦、荧光笔和钢笔等多种笔工具切换 / Implement switching between eraser, highlighter, pen, and other ink tools
显示可独立复用的手写工具栏 / Show a reusable standalone handwriting toolbar
监听手写笔双击、轻捏等笔端快捷手势 / Listen for stylus shortcut gestures like double-tap and squeeze
把手绘圆形、矩形和箭头自动矫正成规则图形 / Auto-correct hand-drawn circles, rectangles, and arrows into regular shapes
接入一笔成形将随手画图案识别为标准图形 / Integrate one-stroke shape recognition to turn sketches into standard shapes
实现全局取色从屏幕内容吸取画笔颜色 / Implement global color picking to sample brush colors from screen content
自定义笔刷样式、颜色和笔宽参数 / Customize brush style, color, and pen width settings
在笔记应用中加入手写输入和绘图能力 / Add handwriting input and drawing capabilities to a note-taking app
管理手写墨迹的撤销重做与笔迹编辑 / Manage handwritten ink undo/redo and stroke editing
do_not_use_when: 需求是使用设计规范组件、导航栏/侧边栏/页签、光影视觉、图标资源处理或应用内多窗界面方案，应改用 ui-design-kit / The requirement is to use design-system components, navigation bars/sidebars/tabs, lighting visual effects, icon asset handling, or in-app multi-window UI patterns; use ui-design-kit instead

需求是开发桌面、锁屏等系统面的服务卡片，包含声明式卡片、互动卡片、透明卡片或卡片动效展示，应改用 form-kit / The task is to build service widgets for system surfaces such as desktop or lock screen, including declarative cards, interactive cards, transparent cards, or card animations; use form-kit instead
preconditions: 运行环境为Phone、Tablet或2in1真机，且不使用模拟器 / The runtime environment is a real Phone, Tablet, or 2in1 device, and not an emulator
设备与服务区域满足Pen Kit可用范围（中国境内支持） / The device and service region satisfy Pen Kit availability constraints (supported in mainland China)
工程已集成Pen Kit对应SDK能力并完成所需依赖配置 / The project has integrated the required Pen Kit SDK capability and completed necessary dependency configuration
inputs: 手写画布或承载组件上下文 / Handwriting canvas or host component context
手写笔轨迹点与触控事件数据 / Stylus stroke points and touch event data
所选能力的配置参数（如笔刷、预测、一笔成形、取色或交互监听） / Configuration parameters for the selected capability (such as brush, prediction, stroke-to-shape, color picking, or interaction listening)

postconditions.statement: 工程中已添加Pen Kit相关导入、依赖或API调用，以接入目标手写能力 / The project adds Pen Kit-related imports, dependencies, or API calls to integrate the target handwriting capability
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show Pen Kit-specific imports, dependencies, or API invocations being added for handwriting, point prediction, stroke-to-shape, color picking, or pen interaction?

postconditions.statement: 界面或事件处理逻辑已连接到至少一种Pen Kit能力（手写套件、报点预测、一笔成形、全局取色或手写交互） / The UI or event-handling logic is wired to at least one Pen Kit capability (handwriting suite, point prediction, stroke-to-shape, global color picking, or pen interaction)
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is at least one Pen Kit capability actually connected to UI rendering or event handling rather than only mentioned in comments or docs?

postconditions.statement: 若接入完整手写套件，则代码未重复额外实现其已内置的报点预测或一笔成形逻辑 / If the full handwriting suite is integrated, the code does not redundantly implement separate point prediction or stroke-to-shape logic already built in
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits integrate the full Pen Kit handwriting suite, do they avoid separately adding duplicate point prediction or stroke-to-shape integration that the suite already includes?
